model: PROJECT-FIRST: one project address (/projects/:slug) for every role with role lenses; LOCATIONS kept separate; CONTROL folded into production.

differences_from_primary.alternative: Project-first: /projects/:slug is THE project; client lens = HOME/PROJECT/REVIEWS/INBOX/LIBRARY, founder lens adds /production/* with the 7 locked tabs. VIEW AS CLIENT = lens toggle.
differences_from_primary.why_strong: Reuses the existing /projects/:slug investment (ProjectOperatingModulePage already has overview/production/reviews/library tabs), one shareable link per project, no duplicated client/founder routing, deep links work for both roles.
differences_from_primary.cost: Firewall becomes render-time role logic on shared URLs (higher leak risk: internal agent chat, costs, prompts); host chrome must switch skins per lens; client app loses a clean /app namespace for PWA/install.

differences_from_primary.primary: Merge LOCATIONS into WAITING ROOM as a MAP state.
differences_from_primary.alternative: Keep WAITING ROOM (/enter) and LOCATIONS (/origin/locations) as two places, both repaired to the same item set.
differences_from_primary.why_strong: Both have spatial meaning in the digital-location metaphor (arrival lounge vs map); LOCATIONS already has a canonical authority; zero merge risk.
differences_from_primary.cost: Two directories to keep in sync; already diverged once.

differences_from_primary.primary: Two internal apps: PRODUCTION WORKSPACE (make the work) and 00 / CONTROL (run the business).
differences_from_primary.alternative: One internal app: CONTROL becomes /production/ops/* reached from the production menu; one shell, one auth gate, one project switcher.
differences_from_primary.why_strong: Founder is the only internal user today; one shell removes the CONTROL⇄PRODUCTION cross-link bugs and duplicate REVIEWS/ACTIVITY/PROJECTS views.
differences_from_primary.cost: CONTROL has its own dense instrumented design language (site00-control.css) and 59 routes; re-housing it is large and mixes two visual grammars.

unchanged_from_primary: Public families (except directory), IDNTY/BLDR/EVOLVE, ACCESS, LAB, runtimes, system capabilities, all collapses of review sub-routes and placeholder settings.
